title: Pi Coding Agent
description: Pi coding agent (earendil-works/pi, npm @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent). Global config home is ~/.pi/agent/ per Pi docs; the CLI honours PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR as a real host env override for that directory. Skills use the open Agent Skills standard (skills/<name>/SKILL.md, Claude dialect) and are slash-invocable as /skill:<name> when enableSkillCommands is set. Slash commands are Pi 'prompt templates' — flat .md files under prompts/ with bash-style placeholders ($1, $@, $ARGUMENTS), so GSD command bodies interpolate unchanged and are emitted verbatim. Pi has NO subagents by design (README: 'skips features like sub agents and plan mode') — no agents artifact kind is declared. Hook-equivalent integration ships as a native extension: hostBehaviors.nativePlugin installs pi/gsd.cjs into <configHome>/extensions/gsd.cjs, where Pi's extension loader picks it up (registers the /gsd command, the gsd_invoke tool, and a blocking tool_call listener — extensionEvents dialect 'pi', surface ['tool_call']). Pi has no MCP support by design; transport is native-extension. No settings.json is written by GSD (installSurface profile-marker-only). Tier-2 support (parity eligibility, not primary).
